model.name: Challenger
model.notes: SAMPLE DATA for building the UI. Not verified. Real data will replace this file.

rear-camera.name: ParkView rear back-up camera
rear-camera.hint: A camera above the rear plate that shows what is behind the car on the dashboard screen when you shift into reverse, with guide lines for parking.

parksense-rear.name: ParkSense rear park assist
parksense-rear.hint: Ultrasonic sensors in the rear bumper that beep faster as you get closer to an obstacle while reversing.

blind-spot.name: Blind Spot Monitoring with Rear Cross Path
blind-spot.hint: Lights in the side mirrors warn you when a car is in your blind spot. Rear Cross Path warns about cars crossing behind you when you back out of a parking space.

adaptive-cruise.name: Adaptive cruise control
adaptive-cruise.hint: Cruise control that uses radar to keep a set distance from the car ahead, slowing down and speeding up with traffic.

forward-collision.name: Forward Collision Warning
forward-collision.hint: Warns you, and can brake, if you are closing in on the car ahead too quickly.

uconnect-7.name: Uconnect 4 with 7-inch display
uconnect-7.hint: The base touchscreen infotainment system: radio, Bluetooth, and Apple CarPlay / Android Auto.

uconnect-8-4.name: Uconnect 4C with 8.4-inch display
uconnect-8-4.hint: A larger touchscreen with sharper graphics. Adds more app integration and is required for some navigation and performance pages.

navigation.name: Built-in navigation
navigation.hint: Maps stored in the car, so directions work without a phone signal. Less important if you use CarPlay or Android Auto.

performance-pages.name: Performance Pages
performance-pages.hint: Screens on the infotainment display that show gauges, 0-60 timers, g-forces and lap timing.

heated-seats.name: Heated front seats
heated-seats.hint: Front seats with built-in heating elements, controlled from the screen or a button.

heated-wheel.name: Heated steering wheel
heated-wheel.hint: The steering wheel rim warms up so your hands stay warm in winter.

ventilated-seats.name: Ventilated front seats
ventilated-seats.hint: Fans in the seats pull air through perforated upholstery to keep you cool in summer.

remote-start.name: Remote start
remote-start.hint: Start the engine from the key fob so the cabin can warm up or cool down before you get in.

leather-seats.name: Nappa leather-faced seats
leather-seats.hint: Leather seat surfaces in place of the standard cloth.

power-seats.name: 8-way power driver seat
power-seats.hint: The driver seat is adjusted with electric switches instead of manual levers.

alpine-audio.name: Alpine premium audio (6 speakers + subwoofer)
alpine-audio.hint: An upgraded sound system from Alpine with a subwoofer for deeper bass.

harman-kardon.name: Harman Kardon audio (18 speakers)
harman-kardon.hint: The top sound system: 18 speakers and a powerful amplifier for louder, clearer sound.

black-wheels.name: 20-inch gloss black wheels
black-wheels.hint: Larger black-painted wheels. Larger wheels look sportier but usually ride a bit firmer.

black-badges.name: Black badges and grille
black-badges.hint: The chrome badges and grille surround are replaced with black ones for a darker, blacked-out look.

hid-headlamps.name: HID headlamps
hid-headlamps.hint: High-intensity discharge headlights. Brighter and whiter than standard halogen bulbs.

sunroof.name: Power sunroof
sunroof.hint: A glass roof panel that tilts or slides open with a switch.

awd.name: All-wheel drive
awd.hint: Power goes to all four wheels instead of only the rear, for better grip in rain and snow. Can switch to rear-drive automatically to save fuel.

sport-suspension.name: Sport-tuned suspension
sport-suspension.hint: Firmer springs and shocks that reduce body lean in corners, at the cost of a slightly stiffer ride.

hood-scoop.name: Shaker-style or performance hood
hood-scoop.hint: A hood with a scoop or vents for a more aggressive look.

trims.name: SXT
trims.notes: Rear-wheel drive. AWD available as an option.

trims.name: GT
trims.notes: Sportier styling and suspension. AWD available.

years.notes: Sample values for UI development. Last model year.
